Facilitation Tips

Before the meeting

Distribute the agenda at least 48 hours in advance. A meeting without a pre-circulated agenda is a meeting that runs long.

Public comment

Use a speaker list rather than open hand-raising. It reduces interruptions and gives shy participants a chance to sign up before the room gets loud.

Action items

Every action item needs a name and a date. "Someone will look into that" is not an action item — it's a way for nothing to happen.

Keeping time

Post the agenda on a screen or board. Seeing the agenda helps the group self-regulate. If you're running over, ask explicitly: "Do we want to extend this or table it?"

Typical Meeting Length

Short meeting 45–60 min
Standard meeting 60–90 min
Heavy agenda 90–120 min

Over 2 hours? Consider splitting into two meetings.
